Q: File location mismatch for custom OTA update download A:

Root cause

The error is not about React Native or Android permissions; it is a filesystem ordering bug in your OTA flow. Android is trying to open the temporary bundle file
index.android.bundle.tmp, but the parent directory does not exist at the moment the download starts. RNFS.downloadFile does not create directories, so it fails with ENOENT.

This is why the failure happens before checksum or move logic — the temp file path itself is invalid.

What is actually wrong in your setup

  1. ensureOtaDir() is incomplete or incorrect
    You must explicitly create files/ota/ before any read, write, or download. If this function only checks the final path or assumes the directory exists, Android will still throw ENOENT.

  2. Your temp file is inside the same directory
    Both
    FINAL_BUNDLE_PATH = files/ota/index.android.bundle
    TMP_DOWNLOAD_PATH = files/ota/index.android.bundle.tmp
    require the same directory to exist first.

  3. Your native override is correct
    getJSBundleFile() is fine. Android will load the OTA bundle after restart. The crash happens before restart, during download.

Required fix (minimal and correct)

Your ensureOtaDir() must look like this, no shortcuts:

async function ensureOtaDir() {
  const otaDir = `${RNFS.DocumentDirectoryPath}/ota`;
  const exists = await RNFS.exists(otaDir);
  if (!exists) {
    await RNFS.mkdir(otaDir);
  }
}

And it must be called before:

  • RNFS.exists(TMP_DOWNLOAD_PATH)

  • RNFS.downloadFile(...)

  • RNFS.moveFile(...)

Do not rely on moveFile or downloadFile to create directories. They won’t.

One more critical Android-specific detail (often missed)

On Android, OTA bundle loading only works in release builds.
In debug mode:

  • Metro provides the JS bundle

  • getJSBundleFile() is ignored

So test OTA only with:

npx react-native run-android --variant=release

If you test OTA in debug, you will get false positives and misleading logs.

Q: get a link from a web site A:

Scraping tasks are not really generalizable, especially not across different sites. And your success rate mostly depends on your general knowledge of web tech and how comfortable you are with developer tools of your browser (whole set, not just element inspector).
Perhaps start with web scraping ch. of r4ds

In this case it's just a regular a element, extract the href attribute and your are done.

<a href="https://www.statistics.gr:443/en/statistics?p_p_id=documents_WAR_publicationsportlet_INSTANCE_Mr0GiQJSgPHd&p_p_lifecycle=2&p_p_state=normal&p_p_mode=view&p_p_cacheability=cacheLevelPage&p_p_col_id=column-2&p_p_col_count=4&p_p_col_pos=3&_documents_WAR_publicationsportlet_INSTANCE_Mr0GiQJSgPHd_javax.faces.resource=document&_documents_WAR_publicationsportlet_INSTANCE_Mr0GiQJSgPHd_ln=downloadResources&_documents_WAR_publicationsportlet_INSTANCE_Mr0GiQJSgPHd_documentID=115374&_documents_WAR_publicationsportlet_INSTANCE_Mr0GiQJSgPHd_locale=en" target="_blank">  
01. Quarterly GDP - Non Seasonally adjusted, Current Prices and Chain-linked volumes at constant prices 2020 (1st Quarter 1995 - 3rd Quarter 2025)
</a>

library(rvest)
library(httr2)

resp <- 
  read_html("https://www.statistics.gr/en/statistics/-/publication/SEL84/-") |> 
  # xpath for the first link of the the last table of class documentsTable
  html_element(xpath ="(//table[@class='documentsTable'])[last()]//a") |> 
  html_attr("href") |> 
  request() |> 
  # save response body to tmp file
  req_perform(path = tempfile()) 

# extract file name from response headers
filename <- 
  resp_header(resp, "content-disposition") |> 
  stringr::str_extract('(?<=filename=\")[^"]+') 
filename
#> [1] "A0704_SEL84_TS_QQ_01_1995_03_2025_01_P_EN.xlsx"

file.rename(from = resp$body, to = filename)
#> [1] TRUE
# check file content
readxl::read_xlsx(filename, skip = 5, col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "universal_quiet")

Q: Filter a gallery using multiple filters (text input and combobox) - Power Apps A:

Try this

Outside of gallery, insert dropdown and for its item property, use below code

Choices(StarRating)

Change Property Code of dropdown

Set(varStarRating,Dropdown3.Selected.Value)

Items Property of gallery

Filter(
    'Favourite Books',
            TextInput3.Text in 'Book Name'  Or  IsBlank(TextInput3.Text),
            Rating=varStarRating  Or  Dropdown3.SelectedText.Value="All"   
)

Q: Understanding list-like functions in transform and apply command in pandas A:

Your function passed to apply should test for Series not DataFrame as apply is applied per column/row (=Series).

Parameters:

func function: Function to apply to each column or row.

The method to pass an entire DataFrame would be pipe.

def func(val):
    global i
    print("Val - ", val, "\nVal Type - ", type(val), "\n")
    if not isinstance(val, pd.Series):
        raise TypeError("Not DataFrame")
    return val.iloc[0:3]

df = pd.DataFrame([[1,2],[3,4],[5,6]], columns=['A', 'B'])
df.apply([func])
